title: Repository L0 readiness v1
description: L0: whether a repository's guidance is true of its own tree (docs/repo-evaluation-contract.md §8). One record per mechanically checkable claim (link, path, identifier, command, build label or config), from the framework's checks (`source: framework`) and the repository's own `static` output (`source: repository`, repo_static.v1). A repository claim replaces a framework claim on the same file, line and claim text. The status class is the part of `status` before the first `_`; only `fail` counts against the guidance, `unresolved` needs a human look.

sha.description: Full commit SHA of a git source; null for a working tree.

files.description: Guidance files scanned: guidance.globs plus also_scan.

adapters_detected.description: True when the manifest declared no build_systems and the adapters were chosen from the files at the root.

by_source.description: Counts per source before merging; repository is null when no static output was given.

errors.description: repo_static.v1 problems; when non-empty no repository claim was merged.

superseded.description: Framework claims replaced by a repository claim.

extra.description: Top-level keys of the static output other than schema and claims, stored as they are.

warnings.description: Guidance the manifest names but the tree lacks: a glob with no match, a missing also_scan file, no guidance at all.

incomplete.description: True when an also_scan file is missing, a guidance file or Bazel build input cannot be read, or no guidance file was scanned; `repo scan --fail-on-fail` then exits 1.

incomplete_reasons.description: The warnings that make the scan incomplete, as they appear in `warnings` and in its order; empty when the scan is complete. Absent from reports written before it was added.

kind.description: Claim kind, such as link, path, identifier, bazel_label or make_target.

claim.description: The text the guidance claims; a repository claim keeps whatever its static output wrote.
